title: Let the Bullets Fly: Multimodal Fake News Detection with Temporal-Aligned Generative Danmaku
abstract: arXiv:2608.22832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The social interactions among crowds via \textit{Danmaku} (a.k.a., bullet comments) on modern multimedia platforms can facilitate both viewpoint conflicts and consensus, providing fine-grained discriminative social signals that can benefit fake news detection. However, the inherent accumulation latency of \textit{Danmaku} in real-world scenarios violates the real-time necessity of fake news detection, making the studies of \textit{Danmaku}-related fake news detection underexplored. To break this violation, we simulate this temporal-aware user interactive process by proposing a novel temporal \textbf{Gen}erative \textbf{da}nmaku framework, called \textbf{Genda}, which consists of: (1) a \textit{Danmaku} Trigger for predicting the timing and intensity of user reactions; and (2) a \textit{Danmaku} Generator for synthesizing corresponding semantic and emotional expressions, thereby mutually constructing a temporally aligned and human-like ps

translated_title: 让子弹飞：基于时间对齐生成式弹幕的多模态虚假新闻检测
translated_abstract: 摘要：在现代多媒体平台上，人群通过弹幕（即子弹评论）进行的社会互动可以促进观点冲突和共识，提供细粒度的判别性社会信号，有助于虚假新闻检测。然而，在现实场景中，弹幕固有的积累延迟违反了虚假新闻检测的实时性需求，使得与弹幕相关的虚假新闻检测研究尚未充分探索。为了打破这一限制，我们通过提出一种新颖的时间感知生成式弹幕框架（称为Genda）来模拟这一时间感知的用户交互过程，该框架包括：（1）一个弹幕触发器，用于预测用户反应的时间和强度；（2）一个弹幕生成器，用于合成相应的语义和情感表达，从而相互构建一个时间对齐且类人的伪弹幕流。通过这种方式，Genda能够模拟实时的社会互动，在不依赖实际弹幕积累的情况下进行多模态虚假新闻检测。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Genda在检测性能和时间对齐方面均优于现有最先进方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种时间对齐的生成式弹幕框架Genda，通过预测用户反应时机和合成语义情感表达来模拟实时社会互动，从而在不依赖实际弹幕积累的情况下实现高效的多模态虚假新闻检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a temporal-aligned generative Danmaku framework, Genda, which simulates real-time social interactions by predicting user reaction timing and synthesizing semantic-emotional expressions, enabling efficient multimodal fake news detection without relying on actual Danmaku accumulation.
